journey_map.title: AI-Assisted Code Review Journey
journey_map.scenario: Alex reviews a pull request with AI assistance to catch issues and suggest improvements
journey_map.goal: Complete thorough code review efficiently with AI helping spot issues

stages.name: Context Loading
stages.description: AI loads and analyzes PR context
stages.thoughts: What can the AI help me with on this PR?

emotions.description: Open to AI assistance but cautious

ai_interactions.ai_behavior: Shows capabilities and confidence for this PR type
ai_interactions.transparency: Displays 'I can help with: bug detection, style review, security scan'

pain_points: Unclear what AI can actually help with
No indication of AI confidence for this code type
opportunities: Display confidence level for PR language/framework

stages.name: AI Analysis Request
actions: Click 'Analyze with AI' or use keyboard shortcut
Select analysis scope (full PR or specific files)
stages.thoughts: Let me see what the AI finds before I dig in myself

ai_interactions.ai_behavior: Responds to explicit invocation, not automatic
ai_interactions.transparency: Shows analysis in progress with ETA

pain_points: No way to scope analysis to specific areas

stages.name: Review AI Findings
stages.thoughts: Are these real issues or false positives?

ai_interactions.ai_behavior: Shows confidence levels, explains each finding
ai_interactions.transparency: Each finding has 'Why?' button for explanation

pain_points: No explanation for why AI flagged something

stages.name: Evaluate Individual Finding
stages.description: Deep dive on specific AI finding
stages.thoughts: Is this actually a problem? What's the AI's reasoning?

ai_interactions.ai_behavior: Provides detailed explanation with code evidence

pain_points: AI explanation too technical or too vague
Can't see the code context easily

stages.name: Accept, Modify, or Dismiss
stages.thoughts: This one's valid, but the fix needs adjustment. This other one is wrong.

ai_interactions.ai_behavior: Easy single-click dismiss, inline edit, feedback option
ai_interactions.transparency: Shows 'Your feedback helps improve AI' on dismiss

pain_points: Feedback feels like it goes nowhere

stages.name: Complete Review
stages.thoughts: Good, the AI caught some things I might have missed

ai_interactions.transparency: Shows 'AI helped identify 3 issues, you modified 1 suggestion'

pain_points: No summary of what AI contributed
Preferences not remembered for next time
